'''Version 1.0.0''' was the first released version of the Scape and Run: Parasites Mod, released on October 14th 2019.  It was 159.78 KB.

== ''Change Log'' ==
Added 6 mobs:

*[[Primitive Longarms|'''Shyco''']]: Similar to an Iron Golem; it can throw you in the air to deal extra damage, and has a large health bar.
*[[Assimilated Big Spider|'''Dorpa''']]: A big spider able to throw web balls at its target to prevent it from escaping.
*[[Heavy Carrier|'''Rathol''']]: A big, slow creature with a large health bar. It may explode spontaneously to release additional minions which are immune to poison.
*[[Primitive Yelloweye|'''Emana''']]: One of the minions spawned by the Rathol; a flying creature able to shoot poison missiles.
*[[Buglin|'''Lodo''']]: One of the minions spawned by the Rathol; a ground creature.
*[[Assimilated Human|'''Infected Human''']]: Living individuals controlled by a parasite who hunt along the creatures they once fought. These kidnap living beings to process them for assimilation in order to mutate into other forms.
